application_realization_envelope.narration: The baker glances at the neatly arranged loaves, then shrugs with a faint, noncommittal smile. "I don't have a particular favorite to keep for myself," they say carefully. "Every loaf here is made with care, but I try not to show any preference." Their tone carries a hint of guarded discretion, as if some details are best left unshared.
